lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 high-contrast vertical lines; spacing is wider in the anterior shoulder region and more compressed/uniform across the mid-posterior torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the 5th line from the anterior near the dorsal ridge and on the 9th line at the mid-vertical level.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 2, 3, and 10 are abbreviated segments that terminate in the mid-flank mass before reaching the ventral fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 5 high-contrast spots located on the posterior haunch, concentrated in the lower-central quadrant of the hindlimb mass.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Horizontal alignment of two spots on the upper haunch and a diagonal semi-connected alignment of three smaller spots near the rear flank edge.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature initiating with a lateral sweep from the base followed by a 75-degree medial turn toward the apex.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: 1.1:1 ratio of the distance between terminal tips relative to the total pixel width across the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: 0.15 ratio of high-contrast ivory tipping relative to the total vertical horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron on the nasal bridge; dual white spots on the lower malar region; sharp color transition to orange-tan on all four lower limbs.
